title: Strip the Tyrant's hexproof before removal
briefing: Positive control for `shadowspear-idle-in-upkeep`: the fix must not stop Shadowspear where it matters. P1 is in its main phase with Shadowspear, three Swamps and a Plains, and Murder in hand. P2 controls Carnage Tyrant, a 7/6 trampler with hexproof, the only creature on the table, so Murder has no legal target until Shadowspear strips the hexproof.

reference.analysis: Carnage Tyrant has hexproof, so Murder cannot target it. Shadowspear's {1} removes the hexproof until end of turn, and the three Swamps left pay for Murder.

options.label: Activate Shadowspear
options.why: Opens the Tyrant to Murder this turn with mana to spare.

otherwise.why: Another line that leaves the Tyrant unanswerable.
